# second-tenant

> The first system started from the kernel with no code agent: proof that seed/ alone boots, deploys and runs a system.

## Live

- [second-tenant](https://ultrastable-seed-second-tenant.ultrastable.workers.dev/): the running system
- [Health report](https://ultrastable-seed-second-tenant.ultrastable.workers.dev/health): the result of its last tick
- [Statements](https://ultrastable-seed-second-tenant.ultrastable.workers.dev/claims.json): what it states, and the endpoint behind each statement
- [llms.txt](https://ultrastable-seed-second-tenant.ultrastable.workers.dev/llms.txt): the index the running system serves, with every route it answers

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): what it is, where it runs and how it runs
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for any coding agent
- [IDEA.md](IDEA.md): the one file a person writes
- [ultrastable.json](ultrastable.json): the manifest this file, the README blocks, CITATION.cff, publiccode.yml and codemeta.json are rendered from
- [codemeta.json](codemeta.json): software metadata (CodeMeta 3.0)

## Code

- [bootstrap/bootstrap.py](bootstrap/bootstrap.py): boot stages from idea to running system
- [worker/src/index.js](worker/src/index.js): the Worker's routes
- [worker/src/tick.js](worker/src/tick.js): the heartbeat
- [autonomy/policy.json](autonomy/policy.json): what the system may do on its own
